purpose: Correct omitted late-1943 US fast-carrier construction hulls and separate current TF58 combat decks from repair returns and near-term arrivals. This correction changes the reinforcement pipeline, not the already-adjudicated 8-Mar combat OOB.

current_immediate_fast_deck_pool.aircraft_band_note: Derived from the HAILSTONE split of 5 CV + 3 CVL at 445-485 ready aircraft, the Princeton/Langley Catchpole support split, Feb raid losses, and US replacement capacity. This is a March-8 planning band, not an exact morning aircraft census.

Lexington_CV16.meaning_at_8Mar: not yet credited as a combat deck

Hornet_CV12.state_8Mar: commissioned/worked-up and Pacific-bound, not yet in TF58
Hornet_CV12.historical_transit_anchor: joined Fast Carrier Task Force at Majuro 1944-03-20
Hornet_CV12.branch_rule: construction/transit remains unless separately changed by branch events

CV18_equivalent.why: Historical CV-18 was laid down as Oriskany and renamed Wasp after loss of CV-7. Branch Wasp CV-7 survives, so the Essex-class hull still exists but should not silently duplicate the Wasp name.
CV18_equivalent.state_8Mar: commissioned/shakedown complete or completing post-shakedown correction; Pacific transfer underway/starting, not a TF58 combat deck
CV18_equivalent.historical_anchor: San Diego 1944-03-21; Pearl Harbor 1944-04-04; first TF58 combat-experience sortie mid-May

Bataan_CVL29.state_8Mar: Pacific-bound; Panama Canal transit on 1944-03-08 historical clock
Bataan_CVL29.historical_anchor: San Diego 1944-03-16; Pearl Harbor 1944-03-22; further qualification before forward deployment

San_Jacinto_CVL30.state_8Mar: commissioned and in shakedown/transit/training pipeline; not yet a forward combat deck
San_Jacinto_CVL30.historical_anchor: later joins TF58 at Majuro and is in the Marcus/Wake/Marianas buildup

forecast_interpretation.8Mar: US fast-deck pool is temporarily compressed to ten immediately useful decks.
forecast_interpretation.late_March: Lexington/Hornet can erase much of the temporary compression; Bataan is approaching forward utility.
forecast_interpretation.April_May: Cabot, CV-18-equivalent, Bataan and San Jacinto create another reinforcement wave even with Independence still absent.
forecast_interpretation.guard: Do not assume all arriving hulls are simultaneously fully trained, maintenance-free, and available to one operation. But do not omit their physical pipeline.

source_anchors: US NHHC DANFS: San Jacinto II (CVL-30)
